scripts.start: node init && npm --prefix backend run start:prod:with-migrations
scripts.start:prod: node init && npm --prefix backend run start:prod
scripts.start:prod:with-migrations: node init && npm --prefix backend run start:prod:with-migrations
scripts.dev: node init && npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.dev:backend: node init && npm --prefix backend run dev
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.dev:all: node init && npx -y concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: node init && npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.build:all: node init && npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
